description:
In a world where awakened beings called “Hunters” must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Sung Jinwoo, nicknamed “the weakest hunter of all mankind,” finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jinwoo has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jinwoo’s journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers.

*Source: Tappytoon*

---

Known as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, E-rank hunter Jinwoo Sung’s contribution to raids amounts to trying not to get killed. Unfortunately, between his mother’s hospital bills, his sister’s tuition, and his own lack of job prospects, he has no choice but to continue to put his life on the line. So when an opportunity arises for a bigger payout, he takes it…only to come face-to-face with a being whose power outranks anything he’s ever seen! With the party leader missing an arm and the only healer a quivering mess, can Jinwoo some­how find them a way out?

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

title: Walk on Water
description:
Starring in gay porn was never on Ed's bucket list. He's straight, he's not an exhibitionist, and he has a decent career in security. That said, he also has a debt that he's been working to pay off for years now, and he can barely keep up with the accruing interest. tags_v2.name: Yandere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are deeply, obsessively in love, often to the point of violence, possessiveness, or psychosis. title: Her Summon
description:
Due to a misuse of a word joke on live TV broadcast, girl group otaku, 'Jin-Kyung' ended up becoming doxxed and labeled as a "child predator", and ended up getting Social Anxiety Disorder. 3 years later, because of his past incident from the 3D world, his love for only the 2D world manifested, and ended up becoming a "Shut-In Otaku"! Then one day, as Jin-Kyung was no-lifing as usual, he was summoned to ‘Another World’, and came face-to-face with a bright-eyed, hopeful Summoner… Interesting enough, in the world that Jin-Kyung was summoned to, his Social Anxiety Disorder disappeared, and he was also able to wield immense power, and became the strongest summoned being there ever was!! The story of a former girl group otaku turned powerful 2D otaku, and the story of a weak and feeble Summoner commences now!!! 

(Source: Toomics)

The two seem to have a natural chemistry with each other… both on and off screen. Will this end up helping their performances? Or will it cause their worlds to come crashing down? 

(Source: Lezhin)

title: Yes, My Boss!
description:
Although Ilene Jung is a popular webtoon artist, she needs another job. A crappy desk job to be exact, one tyrannically controlled by the meanest manager in the world: Jim Kang. He insults her work, refuses to teach her, and even makes her miss an important appointment by forcing her work late on her very first day. To make things worse, when Jim applies to become an artist’s assistant, the artist turns out to be Ilene! In a begrudging twist of fate, she accepts him and the two enter a bizarre working relationship both at home and at the office. How long can it last? Why is Ilene working a desk job? And who’s the boss here anyways?! 

(Source: Tapas)

title: Artist
description:
The satirical saga of three artists seeking recognition. But there can be only one Artist.

A novelist, single, forty-four years old. A painter, divorced, forty-six years old. A musician, single, forty-two years old.

On the outer limits of relevancy in an arts culture that celebrates youth, these three men make up the artist group Arcade. Caught in circular arguments about what makes real art and concerned about the vapid interests of their younger contemporaries, none of them are reaping the benefits of success. But there’s always another chance to make it. When it comes time, out of the three, who will emerge as an acclaimed artist? More important, when one artist’s star rises, will he leave the rest behind? Following Yeong-shin Ma’s hit manhwa, Moms, this plunge into artistic friendships is as hilarious and infuriating as it is real.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

*Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.*

description:
The royal palace is no place for fun and games—here, only the most cunning and powerful survive. After Soon-ock becomes queen consort thanks to the machinations of her scheming father and his allies, she finds herself in the middle of a bloody fight between the king and the crown prince. (Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: An adaptation of the 2016 novel of the same name by Eun-Mi Hyeon.*

title: Something's Gotta Give

unknown.title: 諦める恋愛～叶わない恋～

description:
An impossible crush, a wish to make a difference.

Henry Kim, a 28-year-old private academy teacher, realizes that he has returned to the day he was taking the csat exam. Everything started with a phone call to his best friend Chance, who he had a crush on for ten years.

When Henry received an invitation to chance's wedding, he gets drunk out of a depression that he'd lose his best and his crush and speaks his true heart on the phone. "I wish you never met Lucy..." 

As if his wish had been answered, Henry travels back in time to the point where Chance and Lucy had not met yet. Now, it's up to Henry to correct his hasty wish and put an end to his long and painful crush.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

So he enters the Central Laboratory and meets Kata, the werewolf his father discovered years ago. He is one of three werewolves in the entire world to have been discovered by science. Life at the lab has a long history of mixing work with pleasure, and it isn’t long until the lives of everyone at the Central Laboratory becomes tangled up with one another. 

(Source: Lezhin)

title: Flowers to Thee
description:
A star that loved a stalker, and a brother who lost his sibling.

On the day that star actor Yuri - who suddenly disappeared from the entertainment industry three years ago - makes a comeback, a flower basket is delivered to him along with a mysterious letter. After reading the letter, Yuri is stabbed by a stranger while trying to catch the sender. The culprit is Yuri's stalker, who had been pretending to be a delivery man. Just who is this mysterious stalker? Why does Yuri tirelessly chase him?

Meanwhile, Yuri's new manager Hyun continues to seep in to Yuri's life... Why does this man seem so familiar to Yuri?

A distorted love story between broken people, occurring within the flashy entertainment industry.

(Source: Copin Comics)

description:

In many ways, the tall and confident Lee Tae-Young is nothing like the sweet kid Jae-Young once knew. But, there’s some habits that no amount of time apart can seem to shake. Sure, Tae-Young had always been a little possessive of Jae-Young’s attention, but after what happened…. surely he must have grown out of that by now?! Nevertheless, Tae-Young is certainly no longer the innocent kid that Jae-Young once knew, and now he’s determined to weasel his way back into Jae-Young’s life. From old friendships to hardcore sex, what else will happen in room 1305? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Aedeuri Dallajyeosseoyo
description:
Nara Lee, an ambitious and diligent 35 years old, has finally achieved her dream: buying a rooftop apartment! Little did she know she wouldn't have time to enjoy it, as she ends up reincarnated as the 8 years old Sharon Atrina, a side character in her favourite webnovel, "The Queen's Extravagant Outing." As Sharon, a wealthy and beautiful noblewoman, she has everything she could possibly want, but she's destined to die a pitiful death at the age of 20 after being betrayed by her best friend, Carol — the villainess! 

Rather than waiting for death, she takes it upon herself to raise Carol — whose terrible personality resulted from bad parenting — into a better person, and save both of their lives to change their future! 

*Note: This is a promotional one shot manhwa for the novel of the same name.*

description:

As soon as it is turned on, it became so cool that he cuddled it, but he can’t help feeling a bit weird. As he was cuddling this temporary replacement of his AC, he pressed a button located “somewhere” and it opened it’s eyes. title: Seobeunamui Sarangeun Nae-ga Jikinda
description:
I passed out after a day filled with misfortune. When I later opened my eyes, I was inside my favorite novel. Unfortunately, I was reincarnated as the villainess who was ruined after wreaking havoc due to her obsession with the male lead… That doesn’t matter! I won’t become a villainess, and will instead match my favorite character in this novel, the second male lead, with the heroine! But this is… harder than I imagined?!?! 

*“Are you alright?”*

The captain of the knights who was supposed to be the heroine’s bodyguard ended up as my own. 

*“I got it for free on the way here. Eat it.”*

The guy who is supposed to help the two end up together keeps going off track by 3000%. 

*“Are you out of your mind? I told you to be careful!”*

And the male lead who is supposed to hate me is annoyingly hovering around. 

*”I’ll feed you, Lia!”*

Even the heroine had no interest in anyone, not even the original male lead?! Not only that! 

*“Thank you. I’ll treasure it.”*

My heart started beating for Ain who suddenly appeared without warning! Will Lia be able to save the second male lead’s love?

description:
Living for the sole aim of escaping!

‘Light of Rusbella’ was a depressing romance novel.
Wishing for a new life, Asili Rosé was reborn as the 8th wife of the Estrian Emperor.
She thought she was born with a golden spoon, but it was actually just a gilded spoon?
Once she realized that nothing but ruin awaited, she found a diary foreshadowing the future...

It foretold Asili’s death by the hands of the Crown Prince, Castor!

\[“What does the empire mean to you?”
After asking this, the Crown Prince smiled so very beautifully. And then he killed me.\]

Unfortunately, Asili kept coming back to life, and continued to be killed over and over again. As she continued to relive her deaths, she slowly lost her smile and changed.

…Let’s try to survive first.
\----
“What can I do for my elder brother?”
“Well.”
\----
Pale sky blue hair fluttered finely in the wind. He smiled weakly, before parting his dry lips.
“Call my name.”

title: Future Is Coming
description:
A beautiful girl decides to go to school dressed as a boy in order to avoid unwanted attention from guys, only to come across a guy saying he’s her husband from the future and he’s there to protect her; and while it all seems unlikely, things start to change when he saves her time and again from unknown accidents.

Yoo Min, a high school student who suffers from unwanted male attention due to trauma after being kidnapped as a child, decides to to school dressed as a boy in order to overcome it. Although there are side effects to this approach, she has now become popular with women! At the school, male students no longer approach Yoo Min, who trained in martial arts, and has finally gotten a comfortable school life.

One day, a man named Na Yeon-woo dressed in dirty clothes appears in front of the school and claims to be Yoo Min’s husband from the future. Yoo Min keeps avoiding suspicions from other students, but Yeon-woo then stops her from getting on the subway one day, saying that it will be derailed. Yoo Min takes the subway in defiance of Yeon-woo and is totally surprised when the real derailment occurrs, and yet thanks to Yeon-woo, who rode along unknowingly, saves her. Yoo Min can no longer ignore Yeon-woo, and even finds out that he has a small diary from the future. This leads Yoo Min to believe that Yeon-woo is telling the truth, and discovers that the date of his diary has been cut off, but not before finding out that she is about to die. Yeon-woo actually came to the past from the future to save her and after learning about it, and Yeon-woo tries to prevent Yoo Min’s death by using his diary.

[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4300920), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54219481)

title: Dusk Empire
description:
"I thought we were friends." "Your Highness is from the royal family of Joseon, and I am only a soldier of the Japanese Empire." The precarious relationship between the two men, who loved their countries more than anyone else!  
The two men who perished along with the two empires at their twilight; the unfortunate Lee Woo, who was born as a descendant of the Korean Empire's imperial family and yet had to live his entire life wearing the Japanese military uniform until his tragic death in the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, and Yoshinari Hiromu, his Lieutenant and one of the last soldiers of the Japanese Empire.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6106370), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55044414), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/ghkdghsdml), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/dusk_empire), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H039748114), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H039748114)

***Important Note:**  
This story is based on real historical figures, Prince Lee Woo and Yoshinari Hiroshi> Under the oppressive rule of Imperial Japan following Korea's annexation into the Empire of Japan, the Joseon Empire had practically collapsed. At a very young age, Lee Woo was forcefully taken to Japan as a political hostage under the pretense of educational purposes. Rebellious and defiant in the beginning, while harboring a fervent desire to go back home one day to a free country & be reunited with his loved ones, he maintained his integrity as a Korean, despite his Japanese education. But after many years of being used as a political pawn, all the while helplessly witnessing the suffering of his own people, he was left a broken man by the time the war reached its height. Then, entered Yoshinari Hiromu, a Japanese soldier from low social class & a former classmate, who was assigned as his Lieutenant to monitor his activities by the Japanese Imperial General Headquarters. Despite their differences, the two forged an unlikely friendship as they navigated the treacherous political divide between their two countries amidst the intensifying war.*

title: Holder
description:
An ordinary high school student Jaein becomes a ‘Holder’ who kills and gains time.

Misery and misfortune have come knocking into 19 year old Jaein’s life. The death of his father is followed by the sudden and the death of his mother from a rare disease. And to make matters worse Jaein himself is terminally ill. The one relative that he has left is trying to blackmail Jaein of the insurance money by using his little sister, who is blind.

The situation overwhelms Jaein. While asleep he dreams of a pair of crimson eyes looking down upon him. A shadowy monster like figure that calls himself ‘D’ offers to extend his life by 7 days for every one person Jaein kills. When Jaein’s life is extended for 7 days, he gains the ability to read people’s intentions. After Jaein indirectly causes the death of his grandfather he meets detective Taeoh. The detective knows Jaein’s secret and tells him about the ‘holder’ people who like Jaein imprison monsters inside them. Taeoh convinces Jaein to use his gift for others by solving cold cases. This all changes when he meets the profiler John that works in the department. Only Jaein can stop John’s diabolical plan.

FD refers to "Floor Director" in foreign countries, that is, stage director of the concert hall, but in Korea, it refers to auxiliary production mainly done by broadcasting stations. Mi-soon, who lived alone with her grandmother in the countryside and graduated from the Department of Theater and Film at a local junior college, came to Seoul a year ago with a dream of Cheong-woon to shoot a drama with her own scenario. Office worker Jaeyeon Yoon finally decides to visit a dental clinic after years of running away. He gains this courage partly due to his interest in the kind and handsome dentist Jong-geun Lee, and visits the dentist after hours. Jaeyeon reveals to Jong-geun his issue with visiting a dentist normally, which is that his mouth is very, very sensitive. During the first check-up, Jong-geun experiences just what he means by this, when Jaeyeon lets out a very erotic moan. Jong-geun tries to push away his feelings for Jaeyeon since they are doctor and patient, while Jaeyeon tries his very best to flirt with Jong-guen. title: Oktapppang
description:
**"We are just living our own lives. There's no fixed answer to life."
Stories of people "having the time of your life".

A piece of cake of comfort to you, who survived a tiring and hard day today.**

Ji-Yeong, who quit her job and pursues her dream, Eun-Hye, who decided to break up after a long relationship, and Hye-Su, a working mother who is tired of work and childcare... This work, which depicts the clumsy lives of characters in their 30s, resembles us who are standing on the path of growth. As the author said, "When I was in my 20s, I thought my 30s would be a more wonderful and special life, but now that I'm 33, I'm still struggling and full of mistakes," We, who grow up and seek small pleasures, can sympathize and find comfort in this work.

(Source: Jaemijuui, translated)

In a fantasy world where mystical powers are harnessed through magical gems known as "Loo," Nino is a total outlier. Despite being a low-ranking member of a bandit crew, he has never been able to manifest a single ability, no matter which gem he touches.

title: 35cm
description:
In elementary school, Ban Hana was always the tallest in her class.
But while everyone else kept growing… she didn’t.
Now in high school, Hana finds herself face-to-face with a tall, broad-shouldered boy she barely recognizes — so tall she has to crane her neck just to meet his eyes.
And that boy?
It’s Han Gyeol — the same kid who used to be shorter than her.
The height difference hasn’t changed.
It’s still 35 centimeters.
But this time, everything else has.
A story about a 35-centimeter gap — and how their positions completely flipped.

title: Heir's Game
description: When a new heir to the duchy of Belluna comes of age, there is held the Heir's Game: a brutal series of duels to determine the heir's bodyguard. When Theuden, the new heir, meets Isran, a quiet duelist with a mysterious past, their love will threaten to change everything. (Source: Webtoon)

title: BOO! It's Sex
description: Four high school classmates move into a former sorority house for their first year of college, and immediately discover the ghost of a dead sorority girl stuck in a discarded bottle of tequila. While the freshwomen are settling into college life, Tara settles herself into the center of their personal lives, acting as a seasoned mentor for their transition from girls to ladies.​

title: Sunny Side Up
description:
In mid 1960's Japan, it would be unusual for a delinquent, a wallflower and a misfit to become friends. However, even the unlikeliest of people can be brought together by a good meal!

(Source: Tapas)

title: Tales of Terrible Things
description:
A collection of short stories featuring both human and inhuman monsters.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Ghost Roommate
description:
A young student realizes that his apartment is haunted by a ghost.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Charlotte's Patrons
description:
Welcome to Charlotte's! A small café located in Paris, home of cheap wine but good company. Patrons may or may not start shenanigans.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Unintentional Game
description: Szanon Hailey wants to be friends with his classmate Alexis Go, who’s suffering from a mental illness. However, he is unaware of her condition, so his patience and understanding will be tested. Can he do it?

title: The Post Man
description:
Post.man903 is a handsome young man who is widely popular on Postagram; however, no one knows a single thing about him. Seemingly sweet and charming, he captures the hearts of his followers, but as a man with many secrets and suspicious events happening around him, will he be able to maintain his image? [Updates Twice a Month on Saturdays at 00:00AM] Genres: mystery, bromance, romance, action ~ and a little bit of everything

(Source: Webtoon)

title: The Blue Witch
description:
The blue witch is a story following the life of Ari, a young witch that move to a new town, there she start a new chapter in her life.

[Source - Webtoon]

title: Weather Child
description:
The tale of a girl which the feelings can control the weather. The story starts showing Edmond and Sanni friendship, while she starts to interact with a world that was out of her reach until now. A happy life, full of new friends and experiences, waits for Sanni just outside the forbidden grounds. BUT… can someone like her be allowed to live a fun “slice of life”? Or is her fated to face tragedy, just like the others before her?

- Webtoons

title: Seed
description:
Welcome to the future – where our world has become an exercise in contradictions. We are more connected than ever but alone. Healthier than ever but sick. Safer than ever but ultimately vulnerable. Seed is a story for these future times. Where the relationship between a girl and an AI system that begins simply, quickly complicates things for the entire world.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Live Forever
description:
After a tragedy, Sarah’s conviction to never lose another loved one drives her to discover a formula for eternal life that provokes a fatal crisis.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Drawn To You
description:
You wake up to the main character from your web comic literally in the flesh. What would you do? The story follows Mae, an anxious but endearing artist dealing with the line her childhood friend; Elias now BOSS has drew between them. Seemingly a different person, Mae decides to stay behind that line he set but for Raiden, The warrior from her comic it's the exact opposite! No longer bound by panels Raiden wants to love and protect Mei! Wait a minute, does that say Mei?

(Source: Line Webtoon)

title: Start-Up!
description:
A story about a couple of cute boys starting a company.

(Source: LINE Webtoons)

title: Alone Together
description:
Loneliness. It's something that no one wants to feel. For Adira Edlen, loneliness had been a part of her life for years. After a traumatic experience, Adira moved to live with her Grandma. There she meets a group of friends who teach her what it feels like to truly be valued.

(Source: LINE Webtoon)

title: Showdown!
description:
The story is set in the alternative variation of our world where caught criminals and even their families are sent to the island of Cage, isolated from the other continents by the world government to eliminate all prisons and clean out society. Joachim Ranta, a son of one of the most influential criminals, was born here and, rejecting rules of Cage, wants to live normal life and quit this place. Is it possible to get freedom?

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Illicit
description: Ji Yeon has been backed into a corner. With her mom’s life hanging in the balance, the only choice is to claw her way out, even if that means selling her body to the highest bidder at an exclusive VIP club. When a “person” takes her home, she quickly learns nothing is as it seems. Something will push her to want things she never anticipated.

title: Sometimes. More Like Always
description:
A bully. A nerd. An ice queen. And a dope. Four unlikely friends, two pairs of unlikely lovers. BL coming-of-age story that follows two couples from their high school days and throughout college.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Catma
description: A peculiar figure drags a college-aged girl into his insane search for an equally insane suspect, placing both of their lives on the line.

title: Something like Paradise
description: Bruna dreams of being rich and getting out of her crummy city, too bad shes got a shit attitude, and bad mouth. This is the story of how she became the right hand of a mafia boss. (or is she just his eye candy?)

title: My RP Partner
description: Two boys + love to RP(roleplay)online = what could go wrong?

title: Ghost Eyes
description: Tobias Schneien is a boy of 15 who's been homeschooled his whole life until now. Raised in a church in the woods with his many siblings, mother, and religious father he is wrought with paranoia of being in public with peers by himself. His only comforts are the voices in his head and the blade in his hands until he meets an odd boy who shows him just how fun being "free" can be and life falls into a place Tobi feels he can't escape. Even if he wanted to.

title: Hooves of Death
description: It’s the end of the world, and humanity is on its last legs against the zombie horde. Now, all that stands between mankind and total extinction are Commander Sprinkles, Blaze, Sergeant Glitter and a handful of other fierce warriors. Mythical creatures with supernatural powers and incredible determination, they have sworn to protect the human race. Yes, they are unicorns – but they are also our last hope.

title: Asuras Bride
description: On her way to an arranged marriage, a haughty princess is ambushed and held captive by bandits until she is rescued by a tired, hungry and pissed off soldier. All the accidental knight-in-shining-armour wants is to get some sleep after returning from the battlefield - but having a beautiful princess in tow is making it very difficult for him to do so, in more ways than one

title: The Red Flower
description:
Davante Fixsen, a young boy who has been forced to live in Albern's castle for years; was suddenly asked by Emmie to play a weird game with her. He only had to see the infamous red flower under the mysterious tree. But once he arrived under the tree, part of his memory was lost for some reason, and the red flower was nowhere under the tree. In order to be able to leave the academy and go back to to the castle, he has to find the red flower.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Imaginarium
description:
Verity plunges into a quest to rescue her father from a deceptively peaceful fantasy world. Can she unravel the mysteries surrounding them before it's too late?

Source - Webtoon

title: Aerial Magic
description: The daily life of an apprentice witch.

title: Raining Knives
description:
"Dylan is haunted by ghosts he doesn't believe in. One of them is his victim - his brother. The other is a mystery. In fact, this place is full of mysteries. It seems like nothing stays dead in this town of bad weather."

Source: WEBTOON

title: Pixie and Brutus
description:
This series focus's on the unlikely friendship between Pixie, a tiny, innocent, joyful kitten, and Brutus, a huge scar-faced retired military dog.

[Source - webtoon]

title: Dragon Ball Super Kai
description: After the end of the Tournament of Power, everyone has returned to their lives when suddenly a wandering traveler from another dimension appears in Universe 7...

title: Isola
description:
The captain of the Royal Guard has fled the capital city with the Queen of Maar, suffering under the effects of an evil spell. Captain Rook’s only hope of returning Queen Olwyn to her throne and saving the kingdom from impending war lies on an island half a world away—a place known in myth as Isola, land of the dead.

(Source: Images Comics)

title: Easy Love?
description:
When society decided to hide their faces in order to make relationships easier, Hisae Katou proves it by herself when she develops a crush on her classmate Nobuyuki Nakahara.

Source - Webtoon

title: Aphrodite IX
description:
The Aphrodite protocol was initiated in an attempt to save humanity from a predicted extinction level event. Its mission was to engineer humans that could survive via technological singularity and genetic enhancement to repopulate the Earth.

(Source: Line)

title: Yuuko's Gloomy Days
description:
We often hide our darkest thoughts, pain, and fears deep in the unreachable corner of our psyche. We choose to ignore things that make us uneasy, since by doing so it makes life easier to live. But are you willing to take the chance and face them? See the world through the eyes of those who choose to challenge human values and beliefs, and unveil life's ugly sides. | 
Trigger Warning: This comic deals with sensitive subjects such as self-harm, suicide, and child abuse. (18+)

- Webtoons

title: Every Minute Ends
description: The world changed drastically, the peace that once was alive is now buried under the facade of death and silence. After the first surge, came the carnage and beings of the unknown; a creature caused the destruction of mankind. From there comes the new era of catastrophe, where death means grace, living means suffering, a desert filled with water, grassland covered by rocks, mountain underneath the ocean, and a world full of lies.

title: Erma
description: Erma is like any other normal child. She goes to school, plays with friends, and even spends time with the family. It just so happens that she is the daughter of a ghostly spirit and tends to use her haunting abilities for everyday antics, whether for better or for worse.

title: Faded Away
description: They meet as children, but all of a sudden Mitsuko disappears. Sou waited, but waited so long he started to think he imagined her. They meet again in High School when Mitsuko returns. The girl hadn’t really changed, whereas the boy had changed a lot. …What happened to him? (Source: Webtoon)

title: DAMON Child of Faust
description:
Damons are the deadly creatures of the genius Frau Faust, a scientist who disappeared many years ago. These are artificially created humanoid hybrids, the nature of which has not yet been clarified. Damons need people to experience emotions and survive in the human world. The main character, damon Victor, has a problem with this.

- Webtoons

title: Shadow Pirates
description:
The Shadow Pirates are the new sheriff in town. Beware all evildoers. This ragtag group of heroes will do whatever it takes to protect their majestic, underwater city and the inhabitants of Old San Diego. You haven’t seen justice served until you see the Shadow Pirates lay down the law.

(Source - Webtoon)

title: Waffles & Pancakes
description: Two best friends attempt to answer life's greatest mysteries, such as "what if our butts had nipples?" This is a story of fart jokes and friendship.

title: Colorless
description:
Colorless is a fantasy webcomic that follows the story of Joki, who wakes up in a supernatural city called Aisho, with no memories of previous events. He learns about the creatures lurking on Aisho city’s streets and just how unwelcome humans are.

(Source: Webtoon)

title: Score on My Heart
description: Ashley Bowton is a competitive gamer. As in very competitive. So what happens when she meets someone who's always at least one point ahead of her? Well, they compete of course! Ashley's here to win. But this guy keeps going against everything she understands about her small world, and friendship is regrettably inevitable. It's not so bad really... So why does her heart feel like it's fighting a boss monster whenever she thinks of him? Is this love, or indigestion

title: Intercourse: The Women There
description:
Yeong-sin, the third-generation heir of a large corporation, lived a life of luxury with endless wealth and women at his disposal. However, after being betrayed by a close associate, he ends up falling into the sea. Miraculously, he washes up on a remote island called "Sodo," where he is saved by a mysterious and beautiful woman.
What begins as a story of survival soon turns into something far more complicated as he encounters the women living on the island.

[Original Webtoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/intercourse)

title: Chinguga Aniya
description: This is a combination of runaway handsome short top X cunning, refreshing and handsome bottom
